import seaborn as sns

# Load the data

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')
plt.legend(title='Sex')

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a barplot for survival rate by passenger class and sex
sns.barplot(data=data, x='pclass', y='survived', hue='sex', ci=None, palette='muted')

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex on the Titanic')
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class')
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')
plt.legend(title='Sex')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
